metadata.title: Coach Career IA — your private career agent
metadata.description: Your private career agent: your proof, your guard-rails, and only the opportunities that respect them. Anonymous by default.

footer.privacy: Your data stays yours: never sold, never shared without your consent.

landing.title: Stop job hunting. Let the right opportunities come to you.
landing.intro: Coach Career IA flips the job search around: you build a career memory grounded in proof, you set your conditions, and our agent brings you only the offers that respect them. Without exposing your identity.

anonymous.title: Anonymous by default
anonymous.text: Your identity, contact details and current employer are stored separately, encrypted. Recruiters only see an anonymised profile built on what you can do.

proofs.title: Proof, not promises
proofs.text: Your career memory gathers concrete achievements: projects delivered, measured results, demonstrated skills. They speak for you.

guardRails.title: Your guard-rails do the sorting
guardRails.text: Minimum salary, remote work, excluded sectors, commute time: you set non-negotiable rules. An offer that breaks one never reaches you.

control.title: You stay in control
control.text: Nothing goes out without your consent. When an opportunity interests you, you lift your anonymity in one click — and only for that recruiter.

steps.one: You describe your background with verifiable proof.
steps.two: You set your guard-rails, once and for all.
steps.three: The agent analyses the market and shows you only qualified offers.
steps.four: You decide, offer by offer, whether to reveal yourself.

landing.closingTitle: Your career, your rules, your pace.
landing.closingText: Passwordless sign-in, via a link sent to your email address. No data is shared without your explicit consent.

identity.title: My identity
identity.intro: Your real identity, encrypted in your browser. It is kept apart from your professional profile, which is anonymised.

explain.title: No one, not even us, can read this data
explain.encrypted: Your name, contact details, employers, schools, links and original CV are encrypted in your browser before anything is sent. Our servers only receive and store an unreadable blob.
explain.nobody: Neither our team, nor our host, nor someone who stole our database can decrypt them: the key only exists on your side.
explain.you: Only you unlock them, with your passphrase. It is never sent to or stored by our services.
explain.handover: Your identity is only revealed to a recruiter if you decide so, for that specific recruiter.
explain.loss: if you lose both your passphrase and your recovery key, this data is lost for good. We will not be able to recover it for you. Your professional profile is not affected.

setup.title: Create my identity vault
setup.intro: Choose a passphrase dedicated to this vault, different from your other passwords. A sequence of several words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
setup.understand: I understand that if I lose my passphrase and my recovery key, no one will be able to recover my identity.

recovery.title: Your recovery key
recovery.intro: It lets you reopen your vault if you forget your passphrase. It will never be shown again.
recovery.warning: Keep it offline: printed, in a password manager or in a file stored somewhere safe. Never share it.
recovery.confirm: I have stored my recovery key somewhere safe.

unlock.title: Unlock my identity
unlock.intro: Your vault is locked. Enter your passphrase: decryption happens in this browser.

recover.title: Recover with my recovery key

recover.recoveryKeyHint: Dashes, spaces and capital letters are optional.

start.title: New conversation
start.intro: Choose what you want to work on with the coach.

DISCOVER.title: Discover my profile
DISCOVER.description: A guided interview (situation, task, action, measurable result, proof) to turn your experience into proven achievements.
DISCOVER.welcome: Hello! I’m the Coach Career IA coach, an artificial intelligence. Tell me about a project or assignment you are proud of: we will turn it into a proven achievement, step by step. I will never ask for your employers’ names or your contact details.

CLARIFY.title: Clarify what I want
CLARIFY.description: Salary, location, remote work, contracts, sectors: the coach helps you set clear guard-rails.
CLARIFY.welcome: Hello! I’m the Coach Career IA coach, an artificial intelligence. Let’s pin down what you really want: pay, location, remote work, contract type, sectors to avoid. I will suggest guard-rails that you approve one by one.

INTERVIEW.title: Prepare an interview
INTERVIEW.description: A mock interview for the role you are targeting, with concrete feedback after each answer.
INTERVIEW.welcome: Hello! I’m the Coach Career IA coach, an artificial intelligence. Describe the role you are targeting (title, level, type of company, without naming it) and I will run a practice interview with feedback after each answer.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Coach Career IA is a private career agent: privacy is the product. This page explains what data we process, why, for how long, with whom, and how to exercise your rights (General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR).

content.p1: {publisher} ({brand}), {address}. Contact for your data: {email}.

list.account: Account: email address, preferred language, creation and login dates, version of the terms accepted. No password: you sign in with a single-use link.
list.memory: Career Memory: experiences (job title, dates, level, employer described by its sector and size, never by name), achievements, skills, supporting documents (encrypted on our servers) and guard rails (salary, locations, remote work, contract types, excluded sectors and companies, the latter encrypted).
list.vault: Identity vault: your name, contact details, the real names of your employers and your original CV are encrypted in your browser with a key derived from your passphrase. The server only stores encrypted data that it cannot read; neither the passphrase nor the key is ever sent to it.
list.import: Imports: the CV, LinkedIn export or public GitHub profile you import are analysed to offer you a draft Career Memory, which you review and validate before anything is saved.
list.coach: AI coach: your conversations with the coach and the suggestions it makes to you.
list.matching: Opportunities and alerts: the job postings selected for you, their score and explanation, your reactions; email alerts are only sent if you turn them on, and every email contains an unsubscribe link.
list.contacts: Anonymous card, outreach and negotiation: your anonymous card, the messages sent to companies after your approval, the contact address of the person you specify, the replies received and your negotiation mandate (encrypted).
list.handover: Identity reveal: only the fields you choose to reveal to a company, accessible through a revocable link that expires after {handoverDays} days.
list.billing: Subscription: plan taken, subscription status and renewal date, payment provider identifiers. We never see or store your card number.
list.company: Company accounts: the member’s professional email address, the organisation’s name, website, sector, size and country, published job postings and related payments.
list.logs: Technical logs: technical identifiers, counters and errors, with no personal content (no email, no name, no text you entered).

list.contract: Performance of a contract (article 6.1.b GDPR): account, Career Memory, vault, imports, coach, opportunities, outreach and identity reveals that you request, subscription, company workspace.
list.consent: Consent (article 6.1.a): email alerts, which you can withdraw at any time from the settings or the unsubscribe link.
list.interest: Legitimate interest (article 6.1.f): security of the service, abuse prevention, moderation of job postings and organisations, technical logs.
list.obligation: Legal obligation (article 6.1.c): retention of accounting records relating to payments.

list.account: Account, Career Memory, vault and coach data: for as long as the account exists. Deleting the account immediately erases all this data and all your files; backup copies disappear within 30 days at most.
list.auth: Login link: 15 minutes, single use. Login session: 30 days, revoked when you sign out.
list.card: Anonymous card links: {cardDays} days. Data revealed in an identity reveal: {handoverDays} days, then automatically purged.
list.postings: Company job postings: published for {postingDays} days then closed; kept for as long as the organisation exists.
list.accounting: Accounting records relating to payments: 10 years (article L123-22 of the French Commercial Code).

content.p1: Your data is never sold or rented. A company only receives what you have approved: a message, your anonymous card, or the fields you choose to reveal. Our processors act only on our instructions:

list.mistral: Mistral AI (France, hosted in the European Union): language model used for imports, the coach, opportunity explanations and message drafts. We do not train any model with your data.
list.email: Email delivery ({emailProvider}): login links, alerts and messages to companies.
list.host: Hosting ({hostName}): virtual private server located in the European Union, which hosts the application and the database.
list.payment: Payment: {payments, select, stripe {Stripe Payments Europe (Ireland) processes card payments; it only receives your login email address and an account identifier, never your Career Memory or your identity.} other {payments are simulated during the test phase: no payment data is collected. When payments open, Stripe Payments Europe (Ireland) will process them.}}
list.geo: Geocoding: city names (never your identity) are sent to the IGN Géoplateforme (France) and to OpenStreetMap Nominatim to calculate distances.
list.github: GitHub: only if you import a GitHub profile, to read its public information.

content.p1: Data is hosted and processed in the European Union. We do not transfer your data outside the European Union; if a provider were to do so, it would only be with the safeguards provided for by the GDPR (standard contractual clauses of the European Commission).

Passwordless login, revocable sessions, AES-256 encryption of sensitive fields and supporting documents, identity vault end-to-end encrypted in your browser, data access limited to your account, logs free of personal data.

You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability, the right to withdraw your consent, and the right to give directions on what happens to your data after your death.

list.export: <export>Export all your data</export> (JSON file) from your account settings.
list.delete: <delete>Delete your account</delete> and all its data, at any time, from the settings.
list.edit: Correct your information directly in your workspace (Career Memory, guard rails, identity).
list.contact: For any other request: {email}. We reply within one month.

content.p2: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the <cnil>CNIL</cnil> (the French data protection authority, Commission nationale de l’informatique et des libertés).

content.p1: We only set cookies that are strictly necessary for the service to work: they are exempt from consent, which is why no banner is displayed. No audience measurement, advertising or tracking cookies, and no third-party tracking tools.

list.session: authjs.session-token: keeps you signed in (30 days, deleted when you sign out).
list.csrf: authjs.csrf-token: protects the login forms against request forgery (browser session).
list.callback: authjs.callback-url: page to return to after login (browser session).
list.locale: NEXT_LOCALE: display language you have chosen (browser session).

content.p2: Your browser also keeps, in local storage, the automatic lock delay of the identity vault that you have chosen: this is not personal data.

terms.title: Terms of use (candidates)
terms.intro: These terms apply to anyone who uses Coach Career IA for their career. They are offered by {publisher} ({brand}).

content.p1: Coach Career IA helps you build an evidence-based Career Memory, set your non-negotiable conditions (guard rails) and shows you the opportunities that respect them. An AI agent helps you draft your exchanges with companies, under your control.
The account is created at your first login, through a link sent to your email address. You are responsible for access to that address. The account is personal: one account per person.

list.free: Free: Career Memory, identity vault, guard rails, opportunities, anonymous card, outreach and AI coach within a daily quota.
list.premium: Premium: monthly subscription that adds the unlimited AI coach and the negotiation agent, at the price shown on the Subscription page before you subscribe. Cancellable at any time from your workspace, taking effect at the end of the paid period.

list.withdrawal: If you are a consumer, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal. By requesting immediate access to Premium, you agree that the service begins before the end of this period.

content.p1: No message is sent to a company without your approval. The agent prepares drafts (outreach, negotiation counter-proposal); you review them, edit them if needed and decide whether to send them. Every message sent states that it was prepared with the help of an AI and approved by you.
content.p2: Your anonymity is the rule: your identity is only revealed to a company if you decide so, field by field, through a link you can revoke. See <ai>how our AI works</ai>.

content.p1: You warrant that the information in your Career Memory is accurate and that you hold the rights to the documents you upload. You remain the owner of your content; you only authorise us to process it in order to provide the service to you.

It is prohibited to provide false information, impersonate others, send abusive messages, circumvent the limits of the service or extract its data by automated means. In the event of a breach, we may suspend the account after notifying you, except in urgent cases.

Job postings come from documented public sources and from companies that publish them directly. We do not guarantee their accuracy or availability, nor the outcome of an application. A salary is only displayed if it is published by the company, never estimated on its behalf.
We make every effort to keep the service available and safe, without being able to guarantee permanent availability. AI suggestions may contain errors: decisions about your career are yours.
You can delete your account at any time from the settings; all your data is then erased (see the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>).

We may update these terms; the new version is presented to you and applies from your next login. These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, please contact us first ({email}); if you are a consumer, you may use the consumer mediator free of charge ({mediator}) or the European online dispute resolution platform, before bringing the matter before the competent courts.

companyTerms.title: Company terms
companyTerms.intro: These terms apply to organisations that publish job postings on Coach Career IA. They are offered by {publisher} ({brand}) to professionals.

content.p1: The workspace is opened by a member of the organisation using their professional address. If the domain of that address matches the company’s website, the workspace is activated immediately; otherwise, our team verifies it before any publication. You warrant that you are authorised to represent the organisation.

list.price: Each job posting is paid for individually, at the price shown before payment, with no subscription.
list.duration: A paid and approved job posting stays online for {postingDays} days then closes automatically; republishing it requires a new payment.
list.payment: {payments, select, stripe {Payment is processed by Stripe.} other {During the test phase, payments are simulated: no amount is charged.}}

content.p1: The salary range is mandatory (minimum, maximum, currency, period): it is candidates’ first condition. The posting must describe a real, available position, state the contract type, remote work policy and location, and comply with the law, in particular the ban on discrimination (age, sex, origin, family situation, disability, etc.).

Each job posting is checked before it goes online. A posting that contains potentially discriminatory criteria goes to manual review. We may refuse a posting or suspend an organisation, with a reason communicated by email; suspension closes its online postings.

Companies never search for, browse or rank candidates. Each candidate is represented by their agent, which shows them the postings that respect their conditions; it is the candidate who decides to contact you, first anonymously.
content.p2: The messages you receive were prepared with the help of an AI and approved by the candidate. The information received, including that from an identity reveal, may only be used for the recruitment concerned: you undertake not to attempt to re-identify an anonymous candidate and not to reuse it for any other purpose. You are responsible for the processing of the data a candidate reveals to you.

content.p1: You are responsible for the content of your job postings and your exchanges with candidates. We do not guarantee a number of contacts or the outcome of a recruitment. The dashboard only shows aggregated statistics, with no candidate data.

You can leave the company workspace at any time; job postings already paid for are not refunded once online. We may update these terms by informing you. These terms are governed by French law; failing an amicable settlement, the courts with jurisdiction over the publisher’s registered office have jurisdiction. Contact: {email}. See also the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

ai.title: How our AI works
ai.intro: Coach Career IA uses a language model to save you time, never to decide for you. This page meets the transparency obligation of the EU AI Act (article 50) and of the GDPR.

list.import: Turn your CV or imported profile into a draft Career Memory, which you validate.
list.coach: Ask you questions to bring out your achievements and their evidence (AI coach).
list.matching: Explain in a few sentences why a job posting matches your conditions.
list.drafts: Write drafts of outreach messages and negotiation counter-proposals, within the mandate you have set.

list.send: It never sends anything without your explicit approval, message by message.
list.reveal: It never reveals your identity: only your decision, field by field, allows it.
list.rank: It does not assess or rank candidates for companies: no company sees a list or score of candidates.
list.decide: It makes no decision that produces legal effects concerning you: no automated decision within the meaning of article 22 GDPR.
list.train: It is not trained with your data: we do not train any model.

content.p1: Each draft is shown to you before anything is sent: you can edit it, reject it or send it. Your guard rails are your own rules, applied as they are; an opportunity’s score is only used to order the postings offered to you, and you remain free to view all of them.
Every message sent to a company states that it was prepared by an AI agent on behalf of a candidate, who reviewed and approved it.
We use models from Mistral AI, a French company, hosted in the European Union. Only the data needed for the requested task is passed to them; your identity, encrypted in your vault, never is.
A language model can make mistakes or word information poorly. Always review a draft before approving it. To report a problem: {email}.
